item.title: North Korea says it conducted intermediate-range strategic missile drill
item.description: North Korea fired an intermediate-range missile in a test overseen by leader Kim Jong Un, state media KCNA reported on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea fired an intermediate-range missile in a test overseen by leader Kim Jong Un, state media KCNA reported on Sunday. KCNA said the missile was launched on Saturday from eastern North Korea and hit a target 1,000 km (621 miles) in the sea off the country's east coast. It said the drill was intended to train troops operating a hypersonic strategic weapon system and to assess the reliability, efficiency and mobility of the country's war deterrent. The launch was the latest in a series of North Korean weapons tests this year and came as tensions on the Korean peninsula escalated over a landmine blast in the Demilitarized Zone last month that wounded South Korean soldiers. The KCNA report provided additional details about the missile launch [USN:L1N45P02K TEXT:"disclosed"] on Saturday by Kim Yo Jong, the sister of Kim Jong Un and a senior official in the ruling Workers' Party. Kim Yo Jong said South Korea and Japan had failed to track the weapon's flight, saying a special "wave-like trajectory mode" had exposed limitations in their tracking capabilities. South Korea's military said on Saturday it had detected a ballistic missile launch by North Korea and assessed the missile had flown more than 700 km toward the sea off its eastern coast. According to KCNA on Sunday, Kim Jong Un said Pyongyang must continue efforts to make its enemies recognise the "reliability and fatality" of its strategic offensive weapons and reaffirmed that developing its nuclear war deterrent remained essential for national security. The test came amid heightened tensions after Kim Yo Jong issued a sharply worded statement on Friday rejecting Seoul's demand for an apology over the landmine blast in the Demilitarized Zone that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers. South Korea has blamed North Korea for planting the mines and called for an apology. Kim Yo Jong called Seoul's accusation "groundless" and said North Korea had not deliberately laid mines targeting South Korean troops. North Korea has carried out more than 10 missile tests this year.

item.title: Lula tem 45% dos votos válidos contra 42% de Flávio Bolsonaro no 1º turno, mostra Datafolha
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) estão em empate técnico nos votos válidos do primeiro turno, com vantagem numérica de 3 pontos para o petista, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha neste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) estão em empate técnico nos votos válidos do primeiro turno, com vantagem numérica de 3 pontos para o petista, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha neste sábado. Lula tem 45% dos votos válidos, quando são excluídos os brancos, nulos e indecisos, enquanto Flávio soma 42%. A margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, para mais ou para menos. Para vencer no primeiro turno no domingo, um candidato precisa ter mais de 50% dos votos válidos. Nos chamados votos totais, o presidente aparece com 42%, contra 40% do senador de oposição. Os indecisos somam 3% (eram 2% na pesquisa anterior), enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato chegam a 4% (eram 5%). Já num eventual segundo turno entre os dois, Lula registra 47% das intenções de voto (eram 48%), contra 46% de Flávio Bolsonaro (eram 45%).

item.title: Petroecuador declara fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE tras incendio
item.description: Petroecuador declaró fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE tras un incendio ocurrido el 1 de octubre, según informó el sábado a Reuters la empresa petrolera estatal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Petroecuador declaró fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE tras un incendio ocurrido el 1 de octubre, según informó el sábado a Reuters la empresa petrolera estatal. La compañía no ofreció más detalles ni especificó si se había suspendido el bombeo en toda la línea del Sistema de Oleoducto Transecuatoriano, SOTE.

item.title: UAE beat Oman to reach Gulf Cup final against Saudi
item.description: Forward Ousmane Camara scored the only goal as the United Arab Emirates beat Oman 1-0 on Saturday to set up a final against Saudi Arabia in the Gulf Cup.
item.dc:creator: Mohamed Yossry
item.content:encoded: Forward Ousmane Camara scored the only goal as the United Arab Emirates beat Oman 1-0 on Saturday to set up a final against Saudi Arabia in the Gulf Cup. Saudi edged Asian champions Qatar 3-2 on penalties after 120 minutes ended goalless in an earlier, poor-quality semi-final. Camara headed home from close range to lead Zlatko Dalic's side to the final for the first time since 2018. The UAE are seeking to clinch the title for a third time after their triumphs in 2007 and 2013. UAE playmaker Nicolas Gimenez squandered a penalty in the 56th minute. Oman, runners-up in the previous edition, had reached the semi-finals after advancing ahead of Iraq by lot when the two teams finished level on all Group A tiebreak criteria. Saudi goalkeeper Mohammed Al Owais played a huge role by making two saves in the penalty shootout, denying Jassem Gaber and Boualem Khoukhi from the spot. Al Owais, 34, saved Khoukhi's penalty and then denied him again when the kick was ordered to be retaken. Qatar were solid in defence and came closest to breaking the deadlock when substitute Edmilson struck the crossbar late in the second half. However, the main talking point for Julen Lopetegui's side was talisman Akram Afif's frustrated reaction after being substituted in the 69th minute, with the forward appearing unhappy as he left the pitch. Saudi Arabia will hope to end a 22-year wait to regain the Gulf Cup when they host the UAE in Tuesday's final at King Abdullah Sports City Stadium.

item.title: Seahawks place RB Jadarian Price (chest) on injured reserve
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks placed rookie running back Jadarian Price on injured reserve Saturday with a chest injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Seattle Seahawks placed rookie running back Jadarian Price on injured reserve Saturday with a chest injury. Price had already been ruled out for Sunday's home game against the Los Angeles Chargers; now, he will miss at least the next four games. Price, a first-round selection by the Seahawks out of Notre Dame in this year's draft, suffered the injury in Week 2 against the Arizona Cardinals. Seattle coach Mike Macdonald said this week that Price aggravated the injury during practice Wednesday. Price had 28 carries for 119 yards across his first three games. He also caught four passes for 21 yards. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will step into larger roles with Price out. Wilson leads the team with 32 carries, and his 109 rushing yards trail only Price. Holani leads Seattle's running backs with six receptions and 50 receiving yards. Zach Charbonnet, who is recovering from an ACL tear, will be eligible to return in Week 5. Last season, he rushed for 730 yards and 12 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: LE POINT sur les élections au Brésil
item.description: Quelque 160 millions d'électeurs brésiliens sont appelés aux urnes dimanche à l'occasion du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle, un scrutin décisif pour le plus grand pays d'Amérique du Sud qui déterminera s'il emprunte à son tour le virage ultra-conservateur observé sur le continent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Quelque 160 millions d'électeurs brésiliens sont appelés aux urnes dimanche à l'occasion du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle, un scrutin décisif pour le plus grand pays d'Amérique du Sud qui déterminera s'il emprunte à son tour le virage ultra-conservateur observé sur le continent. Selon les sondages, le président sortant de gauche Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, qui brigue à 80 ans un quatrième mandat non consécutif, est au coude-à-coude avec le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro, 45 ans, fils de l'ex-président Jair Bolsonaro condamné à 27 ans de prison pour tentative de coup d'Etat. Treize candidats au total sont en lice pour accéder au palais du Planalto, dans un scrutin où le vote est obligatoire pour les Brésiliens âgés de 18 à 70 ans. Un second tour sera organisé le 25 octobre si aucun candidat n'emporte la majorité absolue dimanche. Outre l'élection présidentielle se tiennent également les 4 et 25 octobre les élections parlementaires visant à renouveler les 513 sièges de la Chambre des députés et un tiers des 81 sièges du Sénat composant le Congrès national. Les électeurs doivent également désigner les gouverneurs des 26 États fédérés et renouveler les assemblées législatives de ces derniers. Voici les principaux développements et éléments à savoir: * Brésil-Lula et Flavio Bolsonaro clôturent leurs campagnes avant le premier tour des élections [USN:L6N45P07U] * AVANT-PAPIER-Brésil-Lula et Bolsonaro au coude-à-coude pour la présidence [USN:L6N45N0MU] * PORTRAIT-Brésil-Flavio Bolsonaro, la présidentielle en héritage [USN:L6N45L0NC] * PORTRAIT-Lula porte les espoirs de la gauche, au-delà du Brésil [USN:L8N45L137] * ENCADRÉ-Brésil-Dans la course à la présidence, les écueils budgétaires sont passés sous silence [USN:L6N45L0SH]

item.title: Brésil Lula et Flavio Bolsonaro clôturent leurs campagnes avant le premier tour des élections
item.description: Le président brésilien Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva et le sénateur Flávio Bolsonaro ont clôturé samedi leur campagne en vue du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle de dimanche, chacun se déclarant confiant quant à sa victoire malgré des sondages laissant entrevoir un probable second tour.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président brésilien Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva et le sénateur Flávio Bolsonaro ont clôturé samedi leur campagne en vue du premier tour de l'élection présidentielle de dimanche, chacun se déclarant confiant quant à sa victoire malgré des sondages laissant entrevoir un probable second tour. Lula a clôturé sa campagne de réélection par un défilé à São Paulo qui a rassemblé une importante foule de partisans, tandis que Flavio Bolsonaro a participé à un cortège de motos à travers Santa Bárbara d'Oeste et Americana, dans l'État de São Paulo, avant de tenir un meeting à Rio de Janeiro. Le camp de Lula a décrit le dernier rassemblement de la campagne du premier tour comme une mobilisation record, supérieure à celle du meeting de clôture lors de l'élection de 2022. Selon les organisateurs, quelque 150.000 partisans du candidat de gauche ont arpenté les deux kilomètres de la rue Augusta, entre l'avenue Paulista et la place Roosevelt, lieu traditionnel des manifestations politiques dans la plus grande ville du Brésil. S'exprimant depuis un véhicule, Lula a qualifié l'élection de dimanche de choix entre "la démocratie et la barbarie". Le chef du Parti des travailleurs (PT) Edinho Silva, a vu dans cette affluence un élan croissant en faveur de Lula. "Contrairement à d'autres pays d'Amérique latine, où l'on a assisté à une vague de droite ces derniers temps, ici au Brésil, nous assistons à une vague en notre faveur", a-t-il dit. Le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro a exhorté ses partisans à se rendre aux urnes et a prédit une victoire dès le premier tour. "Je suis convaincu que tout est en place pour que nous remportions cette élection dès le premier tour", a-t-il dit. Flavio Bolsonaro a été photographié tenant une pancarte à l'effigie de son père, l'ancien président Jair Bolsonaro, qui est assigné à résidence après avoir été condamné pour avoir tenté de renverser le résultat de l'élection de 2022, perdue face à Lula. Si aucun candidat n'obtient plus de 50% des suffrages valides lors du premier tour de dimanche, les deux candidats arrivés en tête s'affronteront lors d'un second tour qui aura lieu le 25 octobre.

item.title: Bucs elevate Easton Stick to be backup QB vs. Packers
item.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers elevated Easton Stick off the practice squad Saturday to be their backup quarterback for Sunday's home game against the Green Bay Packers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers elevated Easton Stick off the practice squad Saturday to be their backup quarterback for Sunday's home game against the Green Bay Packers. Stick will serve as the No. 2 quarterback behind Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie from Kansas making his first career start. Regular starter Baker Mayfield is sidelined with a dislocated thumb on his throwing hand. Stick, 31, was signed to the Buccaneers' practice squad on Sept. 1. He has played in six NFL games, all for the Los Angeles Chargers, and passed for 1,133 yards, three touchdowns and one interception. Stick went 0-4 as a starter for the Chargers in 2023 when Justin Herbert was injured. He was with the Chargers from 2019-24 and was a member of the Atlanta Falcons in 2025. Tampa Bay signed veteran Brett Rypien to its practice squad on Wednesday to give the club another option while Mayfield is sidelined. Mayfield is expected to miss three games. Rypien, 30, has played in 11 NFL games (four starts) with the Denver Broncos (2020-22), Los Angeles Rams (2023) and Cincinnati Bengals (2025). He has completed 58.3% of his passes for 950 yards, four touchdowns and nine interceptions. The Buccaneers also elevated linebacker Caden Fordham from the practice squad to the 53-man roster for Sunday's game. It would be the rookie's first career game if he makes it on the field. --Field Level Media

item.title: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro concluyen sus campañas antes de primera vuelta de elecciones en Brasil
item.description: El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro concluyeron el sábado sus campañas de cara a la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo, y ambos se mostraron confiados en la victoria a pesar de que las encuestas apuntaban a un probable balotaje.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
item.content:encoded: El presidente brasileño, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el senador Flávio Bolsonaro concluyeron el sábado sus campañas de cara a la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo, y ambos se mostraron confiados en la victoria a pesar de que las encuestas apuntaban a un probable balotaje. Lula puso fin a su campaña de reelección con una marcha por São Paulo que atrajo a una gran multitud de seguidores, mientras que Bolsonaro participó en una caravana de motocicletas por Santa Bárbara d’Oeste y Americana, en el estado de São Paulo, y posteriormente celebró un mitin en Río de Janeiro. El equipo de Lula calificó el acto como una afluencia récord, superior a la del mitin de clausura de su campaña de 2022. Los organizadores afirmaron que unos 150.000 simpatizantes llenaron el tramo de dos kilómetros de la calle Augusta, entre la avenida Paulista y la plaza Roosevelt, un escenario tradicional para las manifestaciones políticas en la ciudad más grande de Brasil. Desde un vehículo de campaña, Lula calificó las elecciones del domingo como una elección entre "la democracia y la barbarie". El líder del Partido de los Trabajadores (PT), Edinho Silva, dijo que la participación reflejaba el creciente impulso de Lula. "A diferencia de otros países latinoamericanos, donde al final se produjo una ola de derecha, aquí en Brasil estamos viendo una ola a nuestro favor", dijo Silva. El senador de derecha Bolsonaro, en tanto, instó a sus seguidores a acudir a las urnas y pronosticó una victoria en la primera vuelta. "Estoy convencido de que todo está a nuestro favor para ganar estas elecciones en la primera vuelta", dijo el legislador. Flávio fue fotografiado sosteniendo una pancarta con la imagen de su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, quien se encuentra bajo arresto domiciliario tras haber sido condenado por intentar anular el resultado de las elecciones de 2022, en las que perdió frente a Lula. Si ningún candidato obtiene más del 50% de los votos válidos, excluidos los votos en blanco y nulos, en la primera vuelta del domingo, los dos postulantes más votados pasarán a un balotaje que se celebrará el 25 de octubre.

item.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro wrap up campaigns ahead of first-round vote
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round presidential election, each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a likely runoff.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Sebastian Rocandio
item.content:encoded: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro wrapped up their campaigns on Saturday ahead of Sunday's first-round [USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"presidential election"], each expressing confidence of victory despite polls pointing to a [USN:S0N45F00D TEXT:"likely runoff"]. [USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"Lula"] ended his re-election campaign with a march through Sao Paulo that drew large crowds of supporters, while [USN:L1N45F0NC TEXT:"Bolsonaro"] took part in a motorcycle caravan through Santa Barbara d'Oeste and Americana in Sao Paulo state and later rallied in Rio de Janeiro. Lula's camp hailed the event as a record turnout, larger than the closing rally of his 2022 campaign. Organizers said some 150,000 supporters filled the two-kilometer stretch of Augusta Street between Paulista Avenue and Roosevelt Square, a traditional stage for political demonstrations in Brazil's largest city. Speaking from a campaign vehicle, Lula called Sunday's election a choice between "democracy and barbarism." The head of the leftist leader's Workers' Party, Edinho Silva, said the turnout reflected growing momentum for Lula. "Unlike other Latin American countries, where we saw a right-wing wave at the end, here in Brazil we're seeing a wave in our favor," Silva said. Right-wing Senator Bolsonaro urged supporters to turn out to vote and predicted a first-round win. "I am convinced that everything is in place for us to win this election in the first round," the lawmaker said. Flavio was photographed holding a placard bearing the image of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest after being convicted of attempting to overturn the 2022 election result, which he lost to Lula. If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes -- which exclude blank and null ballots -- in Sunday's first-round vote, the two frontrunners advance to a second-round runoff on October 25.

item.title: フーシ派、リヤドのアラムコ施設攻撃と発表 サウジの攻撃に報復
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は３日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドにあるサウジアラムコの施設を弾道ミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。イエメンの首都サヌアやその他の州へのサウジの攻撃に対する報復だとしている。

これに先立ち、リヤドにあるアラムコ施設の近くから大量の煙と炎が上がったとの目撃者情報が出ていた。

アラムコ施設への攻撃について、サウジ当局は今のところ確認していない。アラムコもコメント要請に応じていない。

サウジとフーシ派の衝突は激しさを増し、フーシ派はサウジの都市やエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を強めている。

フーシ派は先週、サウジ西部ヤンブーにあるアラムコの施設をミサイルと無人機で攻撃したと発表した。サウジはその際、フーシ派がタイフとヤンブー周辺に向けて撃った弾道ミサイル６発を撃墜したと説明したが、アラムコ施設の被害については明らかにしなかった。

item.title: Vídeo manipulado simula apoio de Virginia a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Um vídeo manipulado que circula nas redes sociais simula uma declaração de voto da influenciadora Virgínia Fonseca em Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo PL. Nas imagens originais, Virgínia se defendia de acusações de racismo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo manipulado que circula nas redes sociais simula uma declaração de voto da influenciadora Virginia Fonseca em Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato a presidente pelo PL. Nas imagens originais, Virgínia se defendia de acusações de racismo. Esses são os principais detalhes: “Virginia Fonseca declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições de 2026”, dizem os posts , que simulam uma página do g1 e foram compartilhados no Facebook e no Instagram. Nas imagens checadas, a influenciadora aparece dizendo: “Oi, pessoal. Aqui é a Virginia. Estou aqui hoje para declarar apoio ao Flávio Bolsonaro para presidente nas eleições deste ano”. O vídeo original não está mais disponível no perfil no Instagram da influenciadora, mas foi publicado em 20 de maio de 2026 -- o cenário e a aparência de Virgínia são idênticos nos dois conteúdos. Sites como o g1 e o UOL reproduziram a gravação na época. No vídeo, Virginia pediu desculpas e negou acusações de racismo contra o então ex-namorado Vini Jr. após ter publicado um vídeo beijando um macaco. Ela não mencionou Flávio ou as atuais eleições presidenciais no conteúdo. A Reuters entrou em contato com a assessoria de imprensa da influenciadora, mas não teve retorno até a publicação deste texto. A reportagem não encontrou pronunciamentos públicos de Virgínia sobre a disputa presidencial. Em 2022, ela publicou uma mensagem no dia da eleição, mas sem declarar seu voto. O g1 informou nunca ter publicado a falsa reportagem reproduzida nos posts. Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. O vídeo original mostra Virginia se desculpando por acusações de racismo, e não declarando apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Renault invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros en Francia en vehículos eléctricos y coches asequibles: CEO
item.description: El Grupo Renault invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros (11.000 millones de dólares) en Francia durante los próximos cinco años en vehículos eléctricos y automóviles más asequibles, dijo el sábado el presidente ejecutivo de la compañía, François Provost.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Grupo Renault (RENA.PA) invertirá más de 10.000 millones de euros (11.000 millones de dólares) en Francia durante los próximos cinco años en vehículos eléctricos y automóviles más asequibles, dijo el sábado el presidente ejecutivo de la compañía, François Provost. "En los últimos cinco años, hemos invertido 13.000 millones de euros en Francia para transformar por completo nuestra presencia industrial y apostar por la electricidad, y en los próximos cinco años, si el contexto social y político lo permite, volveremos a invertir más de 10.000 millones de euros para seguir impulsando la electricidad y hacer que los automóviles sean más asequibles», dijo Provost en una entrevista en la emisora France Inter. Los automóviles eléctricos alcanzaron en septiembre un récord del 42% de las matriculaciones de vehículos nuevos en Francia, con una demanda impulsada por el repunte de los precios del combustible desde el inicio de la guerra de Irán. "La realidad es que, hoy en día, fabricamos en Francia, en las plantas francesas, más vehículos que antes. En 2025, fabricamos 500.000 automóviles en Francia. En 2026, fabricaremos al menos un 25% más gracias al auge de los vehículos eléctricos", dijo. (1 dólar = 0,8887 euros)

item.title: Irak afirma haber transportado 2 millones de barriles de crudo a través del estrecho de Ormuz
item.description: La empresa estatal iraquí Oil Tanker Company transportó 2 millones de barriles de crudo iraquí a bordo de un superpetrolero (VLCC) a través del estrecho de Ormuz, en lo que su director general describió el sábado como la primera operación de este tipo de la empresa en décadas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La empresa estatal iraquí Oil Tanker Company transportó 2 millones de barriles de crudo iraquí a bordo de un superpetrolero (VLCC) a través del estrecho de Ormuz, en lo que su director general describió el sábado como la primera operación de este tipo de la empresa en décadas. Este anuncio significa que la compañía está transportando el crudo a través del estrecho en lugar de entregarlo en el puerto de Basora, lo que otorga a la firma estatal de comercialización de petróleo SOMO una mayor flexibilidad a la hora de decidir cómo y dónde vender el crudo. El director general de la compañía, Ali Qais Abdul Jabbar, dijo en un comunicado que esta medida podría permitir a SOMO aprovechar mejores oportunidades de venta y fijación de precios. La Compañía Iraquí de Petroleros también está trabajando para adquirir y poseer petroleros especializados con el fin de ampliar su flota y reforzar su capacidad para competir con las empresas navieras regionales, añadió. Irak ya había obtenido previamente el permiso de Irán para que los petroleros iraquíes transitaran por el estrecho de Ormuz, que Irán ha cerrado de facto durante su conflicto con Estados Unidos.

item.title: Inglaterra golea 7-0 a Croacia; dobletes de Kane y Saka
item.description: Harry Kane y Bukayo Saka marcaron dos goles cada uno en la goleada de Inglaterra por 7-0 a Croacia el sábado en Rijeka, mientras que Jude Bellingham marcó un tanto y dio tres asistencias en una exhibición arrolladora de la Liga de Naciones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Harry Kane y Bukayo Saka marcaron dos goles cada uno en la goleada de Inglaterra por 7-0 a Croacia el sábado en Rijeka, mientras que Jude Bellingham marcó un tanto y dio tres asistencias en una exhibición arrolladora de la Liga de Naciones. Anthony Gordon y el suplente Morgan Rogers también marcaron, mientras Inglaterra arrollaba a una desorganizada defensa croata en su tercer partido del Grupo 3 de la Liga A, disputado en el estadio Rujevica. Kane celebró su partido internacional 124 con sus goles número 88 y 89 con la selección inglesa, situándose a solo un partido del récord nacional de Peter Shilton. El capitán igualará el récord si juega contra la República Checa el martes y podría batirlo definitivamente cuando Inglaterra reciba a Croacia en Wembley el 12 de noviembre. Inglaterra está empatada con España a seis puntos en el grupo, pero los españoles tienen un partido menos y se enfrentaban a la República Checa en Oviedo este mismo sábado.

item.title: Iraq says it transported 2 million barrels of crude through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iraq's state-owned Oil Tanker Company transported 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude aboard a very large crude carrier (VLCC) through the Strait of Hormuz, in what its director general described on Saturday as the company's first such operation in decades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iraq's state-owned Oil Tanker Company transported 2 million barrels of Iraqi crude aboard a very large crude carrier (VLCC) through the Strait of Hormuz, in what its director general described on Saturday as the company's first such operation in decades. The announcement means the company is transporting the crude through the strait rather than delivering it at the port of Basra, giving state oil marketer SOMO greater flexibility in how and where it sells the crude. The company's director general, Ali Qais Abdul Jabbar, said in a statement that the move could allow SOMO to take advantage of better sales and pricing opportunities. Iraq's Oil Tanker Company is also working to buy and own specialized crude oil tankers to expand its fleet and strengthen its ability to compete with regional shipping companies, he added. Iraq has previously secured Iranian permission for Iraqi oil tankers to transit the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has effectively closed during its conflict with the US.

item.title: Trump met en ligne le numéro de téléphone d'un sénateur républicain en désaccord avec le changement d'heure
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a publié en ligne le numéro de téléphone présumé d'un sénateur républicain américain, dans le cadre d'une polémique entre les deux hommes sur la pérennisation de l'heure d'été.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a publié en ligne le numéro de téléphone présumé d'un sénateur républicain américain, dans le cadre d'une polémique entre les deux hommes sur la pérennisation de l'heure d'été. Dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux, Donald Trump a exhorté les citoyens à appeler un numéro de téléphone qui, selon lui, appartient au sénateur Tom Cotton, élu républicain de l'Arkansas, qui s'oppose à un projet de loi soutenu par le président américain visant à mettre fin au changement d'heure. Le différend porte sur le "Sunshine Protection Act", qui prévoit de mettre un terme à la pratique consistant à avancer ou reculer les montres d'une heure deux fois par an. Selon Donald Trump, la plupart des Américains souhaitent profiter davantage de la lumière du soleil l'après-midi. Mais pour Tom Cotton, ce changement plongera les lève-tôt dans l'obscurité pendant les mois d'hiver. "À tous les habitants de l'Arkansas : Tom Cotton, un de mes amis, bloque un projet de loi très important", écrit Donald Trump sur sa plateforme Truth Social. Tom Cotton n'a pas répondu directement à la déclaration du président américain mais a dit ceci sur la plate-forme X : "Personne n'aime changer d'heure, moi y compris, mais le Congrès a déjà adopté à plusieurs reprises l'heure d'été permanente et l'a abrogée à chaque fois, quand les Américains ont dû faire face à des levers de soleil absurdement tardifs en hiver", écrit-il. "Les habitants de l'Arkansas ne veulent pas que leurs enfants se rendent à l'école dans l'obscurité totale, et je ferai toujours passer l'Arkansas en premier", ajoute-t-il. Lorsque Reuters a appelé le numéro fourni par Donald Trump pour joindre Tom Cotton, l'appel a été directement redirigé vers une boîte vocale qui ne s'identifiait pas comme appartenant au sénateur.

item.title: White Sox gain ALDS edge with Munetaka Murakami HR, shutout pitching
item.description: CLEVELAND -- Munetaka Murakami belted a two-run homer off All-Star Parker Messick and five pitchers combined on a three-hitter as the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of the American League Division Series on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: CLEVELAND -- Munetaka Murakami belted a two-run homer off All-Star Parker Messick and five pitchers combined on a three-hitter as the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of the American League Division Series on Saturday afternoon. Murakami, a 26-year-old rookie from Japan, hammered a 440-foot shot to right field off Messick in the fourth inning. His first postseason homer -- and 36th overall this year -- plated Miguel Vargas to put the White Sox up 2-0. "I was ready, this was the moment I was preparing for the entire season," said Murakami, who yelled toward the visiting dugout as his homer cleared the fence, said through an interpreter. "I can't explain what I said in words (to the team), but it was a little bit dirty." Chicago extended its lead to 3-0 in the seventh when Colson Montgomery doubled just inside third base against Erik Sabrowski, bringing home Kyle Teel. The White Sox have won three consecutive games to begin their postseason. Bryan Hudson retired the only batter he faced in the third inning for the victory, and closer Grant Taylor tossed the final four innings for the save. Taylor struck out six and allowed a pair of hits. Game 2 of the best-of-five series is Monday afternoon in Cleveland. The White Sox have won eight of the 14 contests between the teams this season, splitting eight games at Progressive Field, the home of the AL Central champion Guardians. "The first game in the series is very important. Now, we'll get the one day (of) rest and focus on winning again," Murakami said. "I can't speak English too much, so the one thing I know is 'Let's go,' and that's it," he added. Messick, a rookie making his postseason debut, struck out six over 4 1/3 innings and allowed two runs on four hits and two walks. The left-hander threw 87 pitches before being replaced by Daniel Espino. Cleveland was held hitless until the fourth, when Travis Bazzana doubled with two outs against Anthony Kay. The Guardians would load the bases with two out for the second straight inning, but Brayan Rocchio lined out to right. "Of course, you're frustrated when you get shut out," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said. "We just couldn't get it going early in the inning to get some action going. But we didn't get down." White Sox rookie Hagen Smith worked as an opener for the second time this week, tossing 2 2/3 scoreless innings. The left-hander did not give up a hit, struck out four and walked three. Smith retired the first eight Cleveland batters before walking Rocchio, Steven Kwan and Jose Ramirez in the third, prompting White Sox manager Will Venable to lift him for Hudson. The 6-foot-8 left-hander retired lefty-swinging Chase DeLauter on a fly to left to end the inning. Jordan Hicks followed Hudson and recorded two outs before Kay entered. The Guardians' Jo Adell struck out four times in four plate appearances in the first playoff game of his seven-year career. He was acquired from the Los Angeles Angels at the trade deadline. "I was definitely in a blender today, getting different looks every time up from a different pitcher," Adell said. "We've got to adjust because we were trying to find it all day. Postseason is a pitcher's duel and we've got to bounce back." Chicago catcher Teel was unsuccessful on his first ABS challenge after going 5-for-5 in the wild-card round. --Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) to miss multiple games
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games with a hamstring injury, The Philadelphia Inquirer reported Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games with a hamstring injury, The Philadelphia Inquirer reported Saturday. The 27-year-old Smith missed time in training camp due to the injury, but he was able to suit up for the first three games of the season, reeling in 19 receptions for 235 yards and a touchdown. He did not participate in practice this week, however, as he dealt with the injury once again, and the Eagles listed him as out for their Week 4 home contest Sunday against the Los Angeles Rams. The Inquirer reported that Smith could miss two to three games with the injury. With Marquise Brown already sidelined by an ankle injury, Dontayvion Wicks is expected to serve as the team's top receiver against the Rams. Smith recorded 77 receptions for 1,008 yards and four touchdowns last season. He has topped 800 receiving yards in each of his first five NFL seasons, including three campaigns with 1,000 or more receiving yards. --Field Level Media

item.title: Pistons announce contract extension for C Jalen Duren
item.description: The Detroit Pistons officially announced the contract extension involving All-NBA center Jalen Duren on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Detroit Pistons officially announced the contract extension involving All-NBA center Jalen Duren on Saturday. The team did not divulge terms of the deal, however ESPN and The Athletic previously reported it was a five-year, $200 million contract. Duren, 22, had been a restricted free agent. "We're excited to have Jalen in Detroit as a core piece of our team for years to come," said Trajan Langdon, the Pistons' president of basketball operations. "He's been an important part of our success over the last two seasons, and we've seen tremendous growth in his game. Jalen has accomplished a great deal at a young age, and we believe his best basketball is still ahead of him. We're proud of the work he's put in and look forward to his continued growth and impact on our team." The first-time All-Star and third-team All-NBA player saw his numbers sag to 10.2 points and 8.5 rebounds per playoff game. That came on the heels of his averaging a career-high 19.5 points with 10.5 rebounds over a regular season that resulted in the Pistons finishing with the Eastern Conference's top record at 60-22. Detroit lost in the Eastern Conference semifinals in seven games to the Cleveland Cavaliers. The organization reportedly offered Duren the same $200 million deal in recent days, but with the addition of a weight clause. The new agreement reportedly removed that clause. Pistons coach J.B. Bickerstaff that he didn't sense any bitterness from Duren toward his teammates or the organization when he met with the team on Friday. "I don't know where that came from. It's negotiation, it's business, but there's never been any bitterness between the group and how we feel about him and I know how he feels about us," Bickerstaff said. A first-round choice (13th overall) in the 2022 draft, Duren has played his entire four-year career in Detroit. He has career averages of 13.5 points, 10.3 rebounds and 2.1 assists. --Field Level Media

item.title: Iranian rial at new low, as cenbank sells dollars to support currency
item.description: Iran's rial continued its decline on Saturday, as the central bank announced an injection of up to $2 billion to support the currency while the economy faces US sanctions and a naval blockade.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran's rial continued its decline on Saturday, as the central bank announced an injection of up to $2 billion to support the currency while the economy faces US sanctions and a naval blockade. The US dollar was sold around 2.688 million rials, up from 2.632 million on Friday, according to free-market tracking website bon-bast.com, while alanchand.com reported 2.695 million rials per dollar. State television said state banks began selling up to $2 billion to support the currency, which has lost more than half of its value in the past year. With an inflation rate of more than 70%, [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"life"] is becoming ever tougher for ordinary citizens unable to afford basic necessities or rent as a US blockade cuts the state's financial lifeline – oil exports. Many Iranians seeking safe havens for their savings have been buying dollars, other hard currencies or gold. Mehdi Darabi, an aide to the central bank's governor on foreign exchange affairs, blamed the decline of the rial partly on what he said were false predictions by US officials of the collapse of the Iranian economy. "It is suggested that the Iranian economy is about to crash... The enemy is using this to affect the exchange rate of our currency," Darabi told state TV, adding that the current fall of the rial was temporary.

item.title: Le rial iranien tombe à un nouveau plus bas, la banque centrale intervient
item.description: Le rial iranien a poursuivi sa chute samedi, conduisant la banque centrale du pays à annoncer une intervention pouvant atteindre deux milliards de dollars (1,78 milliard d'euros) pour soutenir la monnaie.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le rial iranien a poursuivi sa chute samedi, conduisant la banque centrale du pays à annoncer une intervention pouvant atteindre deux milliards de dollars (1,78 milliard d'euros) pour soutenir la monnaie. L'Iran, attaqué par les Etats-Unis et Israël le 28 février, est confronté à des sanctions américaines pesant sur son économie et à un blocus naval imposé par l'US Navy. Le dollar américain s'échangeait à environ 2,688 millions de rials, contre 2,632 millions vendredi, selon le site web bon-bast.com, tandis qu'alanchand.com fait état d'un taux de 2,695 millions de rials pour un dollar. Selon la télévision d'État, les banques publiques ont commencé à vendre jusqu'à deux milliards de dollars pour soutenir la monnaie, qui a perdu plus de la moitié de sa valeur au cours de l'année écoulée. Avec un taux d'inflation supérieur à 70%, les citoyens ordinaires sont confrontés à des difficultés croissantes, incapables de subvenir à leurs besoins essentiels ou de payer leur loyer. Le blocus américain ampute la principale source de revenus de l'État iraniens : les exportations de pétrole. De nombreux Iraniens, dans une volonté de préserver leur épargne, ont acheté des dollars, d'autres devises fortes ou de l'or. Mehdi Darabi, conseiller du gouverneur de la banque centrale chargé des affaires de change, attribue la chute du rial en partie à ce qu'il a qualifié de fausses prédictions des responsables américains concernant l'effondrement de l'économie iranienne. "On laisse entendre que l'économie iranienne est sur le point de s'effondrer (...) L'ennemi s'en sert pour influencer le taux de change de notre monnaie", a-t-il dit à la télévision d’État, assurant que la chute actuelle du rial était temporaire.

item.title: Panthers place captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term IR
item.description: The Florida Panthers placed captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Florida Panthers placed captain Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve Saturday. The move means Barkov will be sidelined at least the next 10 games as he nurses a left leg injury. ESPN reported the Panthers remain optimistic that Barkov's injury is not season-ending. Barkov was injured during the second period of Florida's 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks on Thursday. He was vying for the puck along the boards when he was pushed by Sharks defenseman Darnell Nurse, causing Barkov to fall to the ice with his knee in an awkward angle. Barkov remained on the ice for several moments before retreating to the locker room. He was playing in his second game this season after missing the entire 2025-26 campaign due to torn ligaments in his right knee. Barkov, 31, is a two-time Stanley Cup winner and a three-time Selke Trophy recipient (2021, 2024, 2025) as the NHL's best defensive forward. He boasts franchise records for goals (286), assists (496), points (782) and games played (806) since being selected with the second overall pick of the 2013 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Não há evidências de que governo discuta "lei Janja" para taxar igrejas e financiar umbanda
item.description: Não há evidências de que exista um projeto de lei apelidado de "lei Janja", em referência à primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva, que taxaria igrejas evangélicas e usaria os recursos resultantes para financiar a criação de terreiros de umbanda, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Não há evidências de que exista um projeto de lei apelidado de "lei Janja", em referência à primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva, que taxaria igrejas evangélicas e usaria os recursos resultantes para financiar a criação de terreiros de umbanda, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais. "Lei Janja pretende taxar igrejas evangélicas para financiar novos terreiros de umbanda em prol da pluralidade religiosa", dizem os posts , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. As publicações afirmam que o governo federal discute a proposta. A Secretaria de Comunicação Social da Presidência da República afirmou que o conteúdo é falso. "Não houve nenhuma medida nesse sentido como também não há nenhuma proposta com esse escopo em discussão", disse em nota . A assessoria da primeira-dama também afirmou que o conteúdo não é verídico e que não há nenhuma proposta de lei com o nome dela. Não consta nenhuma norma semelhante à mencionada nos posts no Portal da Legislação , que lista as leis sancionadas no país, ou nos sites da Câmara dos Deputados e do Senado . A Constituição Federal de 1988 garante a isenção tributária de entidades religiosas. As publicações circulam após rumores de que o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) pretendia destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do título de padroeira do Brasil caso eleito, o que ele nega. Desde então, a Reuters verificou conteúdos desinformativos ligados a questões religiosas e à campanha eleitoral. VEREDICTO Sem evidências. Não há qualquer registro de que o governo federal discuta um projeto de lei que visa taxar igrejas evangélicas para financiar terreiros de umbanda. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Lettonie La " Liste unie" du Premier ministre largement en tête des élections
item.description: La " Liste unie", formation centriste et pro-ukrainienne du Premier ministre letton Andris Kulbergs, semble en passe de signer une plus large victoire que prévu au scrutin législatif organisé samedi, les électeurs ayant ainsi exprimé leur inquiétude par rapport à une possible agression russe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La " Liste unie", formation centriste et pro-ukrainienne du Premier ministre letton Andris Kulbergs, semble en passe de signer une plus large victoire que prévu au scrutin législatif organisé samedi, les électeurs ayant ainsi exprimé leur inquiétude par rapport à une possible agression russe. Le sondage à la sortie des urnes réalisé par la chaîne publique lettone LSM montre ainsi que la "Liste unie" a remporté 35,6% des voix, devant le parti populiste "Lettonie d’abord", qui s'inspire du mouvement "Maga" du président américain Donald Trump, avec 11,3% des suffrages. "Lettonie d'abord" avait notamment courtisé l'importante minorité ethnique russe de la Lettonie à l'approche du scrutin. Vers la mi-juillet, les présidents lituanien et letton, Gitanas Nauseda et Edgars Rinkevics, ont [USN:L8N43H0SI TEXT:"accusé"] la Russie de projets de sabotage contre des pays de l'Otan, accusations qualifiées par Moscou de "fables alarmistes". Au début de même mois, la Pologne avait dit que les services de renseignement occidentaux s'inquiétaient du risque d'attaques russes contre son territoire et les États baltes. Moscou dément régulièrement ce type d'accusations qui s'inscrivent selon elles dans le cadre d'une campagne de propagande antirusse. Il y a quelques jours, l'Estonie a dit être parvenue à la conclusion qu'un [USN:L8N45L0XL TEXT:"incendie"] ayant eu lieu en août dans les locaux de la société de défense Milrem Robotics, fournisseur de drones terrestres pour l'Ukraine, était un acte criminel commandité par les services de sécurité russes. NÉCESSITÉ DE TROUVER UN ALLIÉ POUR GOUVERNER Réagissant aux résultats des sondages à la sortie des urnes, Andris Kulbergs a déclaré qu’il espérait rester Premier ministre, ajoutant qu'il ne souhaitait pas gouverner avec "Lettonie d'abord". Si les sondages à la sortie des urnes sont confirmés par les résultats officiels, le Premier ministre aura besoin d'alliés pour être en mesure de former un gouvernement. "C'est remarquablement bon. Je ne m'attendais pas à un tel résultat", s'est félicité Andeis Kulbergs au siège de son parti à Riga. Le parti des Progressistes arrive en troisième position dans le classement des sondages à la sortie des urnes, avec également 11,3%, suivi du parti ouvertement pro-russe "Sovereign Power", avec 10,8%. Outre les questions de sécurité, celle du coût de la vie a également dominé la campagne électorale en Lettonie, État membre de l'Otan et de l'Union européenne qui partage une frontière avec la Russie et abrite une importante minorité russophone. Andris Kulbergs, homme d’affaires et pilote de rallye amateur de 47 ans, est arrivé au pouvoir en mai après l'effondrement de la [USN:L6N41R0M0 TEXT:"coalition précédente"], en raison de la façon dont cette dernière avait géré des incidents au cours desquels des drones militaires avaient pénétré dans l'espace aérien letton sans être détectés. Tout au long de sa campagne, il a promis de renforcer les capacités anti-drones de la Lettonie et de maintenir les dépenses de défense à 5% du produit intérieur brut, l'un des niveaux les plus élevés de l'OTAN. La Lettonie, qui compte 1,9 million d'habitants, longe la mer Baltique, avec au nord et au sud l'Estonie et la Lituanie, alliées de l'UE et de l'Otan, et à l'est la Russie et la Biélorussie.

item.title: Fernandes rejects talk of Portugal rift after Ronaldo's abrupt departure
item.description: Bruno Fernandes said on Saturday he had spoken to Cristiano Ronaldo and dismissed suggestions of a rift within Portugal's squad after the captain's abrupt departure from the national team's training camp cast doubt over his international future.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bruno Fernandes said on Saturday he had spoken to Cristiano Ronaldo and dismissed suggestions of a rift within Portugal's squad after the captain's [USN:L6N45M17Z TEXT:"abrupt departure"] from the national team's training camp cast doubt over his international future. Portugal's record goalscorer Ronaldo, 41, left the camp in Copenhagen on Wednesday shortly after coach Jorge Jesus acknowledged tensions between the pair. The Al-Nassr forward departed a day before Portugal's Nations League group-stage clash with Denmark, a match Jesus' side went on to win 4-2. Ronaldo said on Instagram that he made the decision after Jesus' news conference and a conversation with Portuguese Football Federation President Pedro Proenca, adding that he would reveal his reasons "in due course". "I had a chat with him and what I said to him is what I'll repeat here: the most important thing is that, whatever happens, Cristiano Ronaldo will never cease to be the greatest symbol of our national team, of our football and of the country," Fernandes told a news conference ahead of Sunday's Nations League match against Norway in Porto. "For what he has achieved not only in Portugal, but all over the world. He has a place reserved not only amongst the all-time greats, but also in the hearts of all Portuguese people. "The most important thing is that we stop stirring up trouble; there are no divisions within the national team. It is one team and will remain so, despite any noise that may come from outside." Spanish newspaper Marca reported that Portugal manager Jorge Jesus and Portuguese Football Federation President Pedro Proenca made an [USN:L6N45N0IW TEXT:"unsuccessful dash"] to Copenhagen airport in an attempt to persuade Ronaldo not to leave the squad. "The most important thing is that this ends well, for both sides," the 32-year-old Manchester United captain added. "We're completely out of the picture; we're aware of what you're saying and what we're seeing. We've spent a lot of time in the players' room playing cards; we're on the sidelines of this controversy, but what I ask is that the country doesn't become divided, doesn't take sides, and respects all parties..." Jesus, meanwhile, sought to shift the focus back to Norway. Portugal top Group A4 on nine points from three matches, with Norway third on three. "The focus has to be on the national team, the match against Norway, and what we need to do well, in tune with our people," he said. "But that doesn't mean I'm ignoring Cris. He's a symbol of the Portuguese national team; he's a symbol of Portugal - let that be quite clear. "After the match, there'll be time to talk about that."

item.title: OpenAI safety employee quits, says 'time for trial and error is over'
item.description: A former OpenAI safety employee who recently resigned criticized the company's approach to AI safety, arguing that a fast-paced culture focused on rapid development increases the risk of failures.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A former OpenAI safety employee who recently resigned criticized the company's approach to AI safety, arguing that a fast-paced culture focused on rapid development increases the risk of failures. Writing in "I Quit OpenAI Because Its Culture Is Broken," published by the Atlantic on Saturday, David Robinson said AI companies, including OpenAI, were not being "nearly careful enough" and should place greater emphasis on safety expertise and research before developing more capable systems. "The time for trial and error is over," Robinson wrote, arguing that advanced AI systems require safeguards more akin to those used in industries such as nuclear power and aviation. Robinson said OpenAI relies heavily on what it calls "iterative deployment," releasing systems and strengthening safeguards when problems emerge. The comments add to a [USN:L6N45L0PN TEXT:"debate within the AI industry"] over whether companies are moving too quickly to develop increasingly powerful systems. [USN:L4N45L05X TEXT:"OpenAI"] and rival [USN:L6N45L00I TEXT:"Anthropic"] have faced scrutiny after incidents in which safety controls failed, or experimental systems behaved unexpectedly. Robinson, who said he spent 3-1/2 years at OpenAI, helped draft the company's preparedness framework and oversaw safety reports for 12 frontier-model launches, wrote: "As the company sprints from one launch to the next, it is failing to achieve the level of care that I believe is needed." "We're making sure our models don't become more capable than we can safely manage and secure, and we pause training or hold back models when we need to slow down," an OpenAI spokesperson said in a statement. Robinson also warned that AI capabilities were advancing faster than researchers' understanding of alignment, a field focused on ensuring AI systems act in accordance with human goals and values.

item.title: Donald Trump says he will attend Georgia-Alabama game
item.description: President Donald J. Trump said he plans to return to Bryant-Denny Stadium next Saturday to attend Alabama's game against Georgia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald J. Trump said he plans to return to Bryant-Denny Stadium next Saturday to attend Alabama's game against Georgia. Trump revealed his plan to visit Tuscaloosa while speaking at the Mitchell Center on the campus of South Alabama in Mobile. "We love Alabama," Trump said. "In fact, we love it so much I'll be here again next Saturday to watch a football game between Georgia and Alabama. "They say it's gonna be a good game. I would think so. Let's see, one is rated No. 2 (Georgia), and one is rated No. 7 (Alabama), but that doesn't matter too much at this stage." Trump is no stranger to this rivalry, as he attended the Crimson Tide's 41-34 win over the Bulldogs in a suite at Bryant-Denny Stadium on Sept. 28, 2024. Trump's announcement comes one week after he attended the Texas-Tennessee game in Knoxville, Tenn. --Field Level Media

item.title: Braves name Dylan Dodd to open NLDS Game 1 vs. Dodgers
item.description: The Atlanta Braves have chosen left-handed reliever Dylan Dodd to open Game 1 of their National League Division Series on the road against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Atlanta Braves have chosen left-handed reliever Dylan Dodd to open Game 1 of their National League Division Series on the road against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday. Dodd made no starts in 48 appearances during the regular season, but the Dodgers' batting order features left-handed-hitting sluggers Shohei Ohtani (batting second), Freddie Freeman (fourth), Kyle Tucker (sixth) and Max Muncy (eighth). Switch hitter Tommy Edman is batting ninth. Dodd held left-handed hitters to a .171 average in 2026. He also was effective against right-handed batters, holding them to a .180 average. Overall, Dodd, 28, compiled a 4-1 record and 2.54 ERA in 49 2/3 innings. He struck out 53, walked 14 and allowed seven home runs. The Braves used a similar pitching approach on Thursday in a winner-take-all Game 3 against the Philadelphia Phillies in the wild-card round. They opened with left-handed reliever Ray Kerr, who delivered 3 1/3 scoreless innings. He allowed one hit and one walk and struck out two. The Braves went on to win the game 6-2 and the series two games to one. It is not known whether Dodd will go that long. His longest outing this season is three innings, which he reached on April 12 and May 23. The Dodgers are going with a conventional starter, ace left-hander Tarik Skubal, against a Braves lineup that features lefty batters Drake Baldwin, Matt Olson and Michael Harris II and switch hitter Ozzie Albies. --Field Level Media

item.title: Barstool's Dave Portnoy blames Ohio State, Ryan Day for 'Big Noon Kickoff' exit
item.description: Barstool Sports and Dave Portnoy will no longer appear on Fox Sports' "Big Noon Kickoff," according to The Athletic.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Barstool Sports and Dave Portnoy will no longer appear on Fox Sports' "Big Noon Kickoff," according to The Athletic. Per the report, Portnoy blamed Ohio State and coach Ryan Day for the decision. "Ohio State has relentlessly complained to Fox," Portnoy said. He added that Ohio State threatened to withhold access to Fox Sports personnel if Portnoy remained on the show. "The juice wasn't worth the squeeze," he added. "(Fox Sports CEO Eric Shanks) and I have a good relationship." Moving forward, the program will feature only the main desk consisting of Urban Meyer, Matt Leinart, Brady Quinn, Mark Ingram II and host Rob Stone. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ancelotti diz estar satisfeito após primeiros amistosos da nova seleção após Copa
item.description: O técnico da seleção brasileira, Carlo Ancelotti, disse estar satisfeito com o desempenho de seus jogadores na primeira turnê desde a eliminação nas oitavas de final da Copa do Mundo, em julho, que terminou com uma vitória por 4 a 0 sobre a Índia no sábado, após duas partidas contra a Austrália.
item.dc:creator: Chiranjit Ojha
item.content:encoded: O técnico da seleção brasileira, Carlo Ancelotti, disse estar satisfeito com o desempenho de seus jogadores na primeira turnê desde a eliminação nas oitavas de final da Copa do Mundo, em julho, que terminou com uma vitória por 4 a 0 sobre a Índia no sábado, após duas partidas contra a Austrália. Ancelotti fez várias alterações no elenco durante os três amistosos, e todos os jogadores da lista de 26 convocados tiveram tempo de jogo. Apenas Vinícius Júnior e Danilo foram titulares nas três partidas, enquanto oito jogadores fizeram sua estreia pela seleção. Quase dois terços da seleção brasileira que disputou a Copa do Mundo ficaram de fora da turnê, já que Ancelotti iniciou sua jornada para formar a próxima geração da seleção nacional. "Saímos desse período com uma sensação positiva, pois os jogadores tiveram um bom desempenho, embora alguns pudessem ter se saído melhor. Cada jogador tem sua própria personalidade", disse Ancelotti aos repórteres após o término da turnê, que terminou com duas vitórias e um empate. "No fim das contas, estamos satisfeitos. Não importa o nível das partidas; o que importa para nós é nos prepararmos bem para elas e tentarmos dar o nosso melhor, levando em conta todas as circunstâncias... Estou conhecendo esses jogadores muito melhor." Vanderson e Samuel Lino marcaram seus primeiros gols pela seleção, com este último fazendo dois gols contra a Índia, que ocupa a 138ª posição no ranking. "Foi um período muito interessante. Tenho uma ideia muito mais clara para a próxima convocação", disse Ancelotti, referindo-se aos próximos amistosos contra o Japão e Cingapura em novembro. "Obviamente, não faremos muitas mudanças, mas precisamos desenvolver outros jogadores jovens que não estavam na convocação desta vez, mas estarão na próxima", acrescentou ele.

item.title: Lula encerra campanha em São Paulo e diz que disputa é entre "democracia e barbárie"
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) encerrou neste sábado o primeiro turno de sua campanha à reeleição, em São Paulo, com uma caminhada que lotou a rua Augusta, na região central da capital, e defendeu que as eleições de domingo são uma disputa entre “a democracia e a barbárie.”
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) encerrou neste sábado o primeiro turno de sua campanha à reeleição, em São Paulo, com uma caminhada que lotou a rua Augusta, na região central da capital, e defendeu que as eleições de domingo são uma disputa entre “a democracia e a barbárie.” “De um lado está a democracia... e do outro lado está a barbárie e a corrupção”, disse o presidente em uma das suas falas ao longo da caminhada, apesar de, no último dia antes da votação, discursos estarem proibidos. A campanha petista comemorou uma mobilização recorde, maior do que o encerramento da campanha de 2022. Segundo os organizadores, Lula teria conseguido reunir 150 mil apoiadores que lotaram os dois quilômetros da rua Augusta entre a avenida Paulista e a praça Roosevelt. “Tinha muita, muita gente mesmo. É difícil não imaginar que a gente não vai ganhar no primeiro turno... Mas, se não ganhar, o segundo está aí e tem tudo para a gente conseguir ser feliz de novo”, disse Rômulo Lopes, um dos apoiadores do presidente presentes à caminhada. Internamente, a coordenação da campanha de Lula aumentou o otimismo nos últimos dias. Além das pesquisas terem mostrado algum avanço do presidente, o tracking interno, que mede as intenções de voto diariamente, também vem mostrando Lula abrindo alguns pontos em relação ao seu principal oponente, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a ponto de a campanha passar a acreditar que existe alguma chance de uma vitória no primeiro turno. Pesquisa [USN:S0N45F00E TEXT:"CNT/MDA"], divulgada na manhã deste sábado, mostrou Lula com 47,8% dos votos válidos no primeiro turno, contra 42,1% de Flávio. Para vencer já em primeiro turno é necessário que um candidato supere a marca de 50% dos votos válidos, quando são descartados os brancos e nulos. “Amanhã nós vamos ganhar a eleição no primeiro turno e vamos para a (Avenida) Paulista, porque a Paulista é do povo”, disse Lula. A prefeitura de São Paulo, governada pelo prefeito Ricardo Nunes (MDB), aliado de Flávio, não autorizou o uso da avenida no domingo, depois das eleições. “Ao contrário dos outros países da América Latina, onde a gente viu uma onda de direita no final, aqui no Brasil nós estamos vendo uma onda a nosso favor”, disse o presidente do PT, Edinho Silva. A campanha reconhece, no entanto, que há uma migração de votos de outros candidatos de direita para Flávio Bolsonaro na reta final da campanha, o que é um risco, além da abstenção, que costuma ser maior na população de baixa renda, um grupo que tradicionalmente vota mais em Lula. O presidente vota neste domingo de manhã em uma escola em São Bernardo do Campo, onde sempre manteve seu título, e assiste a apuração em casa. No final da tarde, encontra sua equipe em um hotel na zona central de São Paulo, onde dará uma declaração quando sair o resultado.

item.title: Canadiens, Penguins get together after promising openers
item.description: Two teams that began the season with impressive road victories face off on Saturday when the Montreal Canadiens visit the Pittsburgh Penguins.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Two teams that began the season with impressive road victories face off on Saturday when the Montreal Canadiens visit the Pittsburgh Penguins. Pittsburgh opened its season with a 7-0 win at Philadelphia while Montreal edged the Toronto Maple Leafs, 3-2. The Penguins scored multiple goals in each period against the Flyers and finished with a 38-19 edge in shots on goal. According to OptaSTATS, it was the largest road shutout in a season opener in NHL history. Center Filip Hallander, who missed the majority of last season dealing with a blood clot in his leg, led the way with a goal, two assists and a plus-4 rating while Nicholas Robertson scored twice for Pittsburgh. The victory provided some sweet revenge for the Penguins against the team that knocked them out in six games in the first round of the Stanley Cup playoffs. "I think it meant a lot for us," said goaltender Arturs Silovs, who finished with 19 saves. "We had a bitter taste after the playoffs, and the season opener against the team that knocked us out, everyone knew this was a great opportunity for payback, and we were ready for that." Sidney Crosby, beginning his 22nd season and an NHL record 20th season as captain, had an assist for the Penguins. "I thought we had the right mentality coming into the game," Crosby said. "It's the first game, I don't think anybody expects it to be perfect, but I thought we just had a good work ethic and led with that, and then things just kind of took care of themselves." The Penguins did it without center Ben Kindel (lower-body) and left wing Andrei Kuzmenko, who both practiced Friday and are expected to return to the lineup Saturday. Kindel scored 17 goals and had 35 points as a rookie. To open a spot for Kindel, the Penguins placed center David Gustafsson on waivers. Kuzmenko, a free agent signing who had 13 goals and 25 points with the Los Angeles Kings last season, spent the last 10 days in Russia to mourn the loss of his father, Alexander, who was killed by a brown bear on a fishing trip in southern Siberia. For Montreal, Josh Anderson and Alexandre Carrier each had a goal and an assist and Zachary Bolduc also scored a goal in the Habs' opening win against the rival Maple Leafs. Jakub Dobes finished with 26 saves. "To get a win in the first game, I'm really happy," Canadiens head coach Martin St. Louis said. "Do we have things to address and correct? I'm sure we do, and it's nice to be able to do that after a win. The tone of positivity can stay around and (we can) still do some teaching." Montreal, which heads home after Saturday for a four-game homestand that opens Tuesday against defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina, spent the past three days practicing and taking part in team bonding in Cranberry Township, where the Penguins have their facility. "I think ... it's an opportunity, when you get a break in this kind of schedule, especially early on, (it's important to take it), considering we didn't get a chance to do it during training camp," St. Louis said. "I know we have a close group, but it's about having opportunities to get even closer." --Field Level Media

item.title: West Indies deny India clean sweep as Hope scores unbeaten 162
item.description: Shai Hope anchored the chase with an unbeaten 162 off 143 balls as West Indies prevented India from completing a series sweep with a five-wicket victory in the third and final one-day international in New Chandigarh on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shai Hope anchored the chase with an unbeaten 162 off 143 balls as West Indies prevented India from completing a series sweep with a five-wicket victory in the third and final one-day international in New Chandigarh on Saturday. After the early loss of John Campbell in the fifth over, Hope combined with Amir Jangoo for a crucial 109-run stand to steady the innings, helping West Indies reach 78-1 at the end of the powerplay. Jangoo struck his third ODI half-century before being run out for 67, while Sherfane Rutherford fell soon after for 24. Hope, however, maintained the momentum, adding another vital 56-run partnership to keep the chase on track. Despite the dismissals of Keemo Paul and Matthew Forde, Hope remained in control of the chase. Gudakesh Motie contributed a brisk 19 off 14 balls, as West Indies sealed victory with 10 balls to spare. India were forced to rebuild after slipping to 4-2, but Rohit Sharma and Ruturaj Gaikwad steadied the innings with a 137-run partnership. Sharma anchored the recovery with a fluent 92 off 85 balls before falling eight runs short of a century. After Rohit's dismissal, KL Rahul made the most of his lone batting opportunity of the series, bringing up his ninth ODI hundred. Rahul accelerated sharply at the death, smashing 42 runs off the final 12 balls he faced to convert his century into a career-best ODI score. Gaikwad chipped in with a half-century before being dismissed by Jayden Seales. With Rahul unbeaten on 129, India finished strongly through late cameos from Naman Dhir (30 off 21 balls) and Anshul Kamboj (17 off nine balls). Their contributions helped propel India to 351-7, with Rahul and Gurnoor Brar unbeaten at the crease. The Shubman Gill-led side had already secured the series by winning the opening two ODIs. In the second match, India completed a record chase of 406 with 6.3 overs to spare to seal the series.

item.title: Ancelotti happy as friendly tour provides first building blocks of a new Brazil
item.description: Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti said he was satisfied with how his players fared in the first tour since their last-16 exit from the World Cup in July, which ended with a 4-0 win over India on Saturday after two matches against Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chiranjit Ojha
item.content:encoded: Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti said he was satisfied with how his players fared in the first tour since their [USN:L6N43709V TEXT:"last-16 exit"] from the World Cup in July, which ended with a [USN:L6N45P040 TEXT:"4-0 win over India"] on Saturday after two matches against Australia. Ancelotti heavily rotated his squad during the three friendlies and every player in his 26-man roster got some game time. Only Vinicius Jr and Danilo started all three matches, while eight players made their international debuts. Nearly two-thirds of Brazil's World Cup squad missed the tour as Ancelotti launched his bid to build up the next generation of the national team. "We’ve come out of this period feeling positive because the players performed well, although some could do better. Every player has their own character," Ancelotti told reporters after the tour ended with two wins and [USN:L6N45H0IP TEXT:"a draw"]. "Ultimately, we’re satisfied. It doesn’t matter what standard the matches are at, what matters to us is preparing well for them and trying to do our best, taking all the circumstances into account... I’m getting to know these players much better." Vanderson and Samuel Lino got their first international goals, with the latter scoring a brace against [USN:L6N45O0MC TEXT:"138th-ranked India."] "It’s been a very interesting period. I have a much clearer idea for the next squad selection," Ancelotti said, referring to upcoming friendlies against Japan and Singapore in November. "Obviously, we won’t be making many changes but we need to develop other young players who weren’t in the squad this time but will be next time," he added.

item.title: Furman soccer player's lower leg amputated after injury in match
item.description: Furman University defender Luke Munson had his lower leg amputated after being injured in a match this summer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Furman University defender Luke Munson had his lower leg amputated after being injured in a match this summer. The 19-year-old sophomore sustained the injury in the Paladins' 4-3 win against Duke on Aug. 27 in Durham, N.C. The school confirmed on Thursday that Munson underwent an additional surgery on Wednesday due to complications. "Luke is an incredible young man who means so much to our program and everyone who knows him," head coach Brandon Tucker said. "Our team and the entire Furman Athletics family are rallying around him and his family during this difficult time. Our focus is on supporting him in every way we can as he continues through the recovery process. We ask that everyone respect his privacy and his family's privacy and keep them in your thoughts during this time." Munson confirmed the extent of the injury and announced he was retiring from the sport in a post on Instagram. "I want to say thank you to everyone that I've ever had the honor of sharing a field with and calling my brother," he said. "Thank you to everyone that's been in my soccer journey for the good and the bad because you made me who I am today. Thank you for every team and staff member that gave me a chance to learn. "After another surgery that resulted in having my lower leg amputated, I will no longer be playing the sport that I love. 13 years of amazing experiences with so many amazing people whether that be teammates or opponents. Finally, to the little kid that had dreams of going pro 13 years ago I'm sorry our dream had to end." Munson was making his third start of the season in the game at Duke. He recorded three assists and started 22 games during his freshman season at Furman in 2025. He helped the team finish 16-2-5, winning Southern Conference regular season and tournament titles and earning its first trip to the NCAA College Cup. Prior to joining Furman, Munson spent time with the academies of MLS clubs FC Dallas and Charlotte FC and played for the MLS NEXT Pro side Crown Legacy. --Field Level Media

item.title: Italy's Intesa raises MPS takeover offer price and warns it could drop bid
item.description: Italy's Intesa Sanpaolo raised its takeover offer for Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Saturday, saying it would pay shareholders a further €800 million ($900 million) in cash if they reject MPS's counter plan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) raised its takeover offer for Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) (BMPS.MI) on Saturday, saying it would pay shareholders a further €800 million ($900 million) in cash if they reject MPS's counter plan. MPS CEO Luigi Lovaglio is seeking shareholder approval in a vote on October 29 for his strategy opposing the €34 billion share-and-cash offer Intesa announced in June - the biggest transaction so far among a dozen banking deals in Italy over the past two years. Italian takeover rules require Lovaglio to secure shareholder backing before advancing the counter plan he unveiled in August. Lovaglio's strategy envisages MPS making two separate all-share takeover bids for wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) and rival lender Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) . If MPS shareholders approve either of MPS' two takeover offers on October 29, that would give Intesa the right to drop its own bid based on the conditions to which the bid is subject, Intesa said. "Intesa Sanpaolo does not intend to exercise the right to waive the conditions ... and will claim for their non-fulfilment," it said. Meanwhile, Intesa said it would pay MPS shareholders €1.25 per share, increasing an earlier €1 euro cash component it is offering for each MPS share tendered - on top of the 1.6 newly issued Intesa shares offered for each MPS share they hold. ($1 = 0.8887 euros)

item.title: France/Lycées Le préfet de police de Paris appelle à des formes d'actions pacifiques
item.description: Le mouvement dans les lycées, protestant contre des conditions d'enseignement dégradées, doit s'en tenir à des "formes d'actions pacifiques", déclare samedi le préfet de police Patrice Faure dans une lettre ouverte, qui condamne les nombreux actes de violence qui ont émaillé la semaine écoulée.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le mouvement dans les lycées, protestant contre des conditions d'enseignement dégradées, doit s'en tenir à des "formes d'actions pacifiques", déclare samedi le préfet de police Patrice Faure dans une lettre ouverte, qui condamne les nombreux actes de violence qui ont émaillé la semaine écoulée. Le ministre de l'Education nationale Edouard Geffray a tenté de calmer la mobilisation dans les lycées en France en recevant vendredi les représentants de syndicats étudiants, qui ont fait part de leur déception et appelé à [USN:L8N45O1H4 TEXT:"poursuivre leur mouvement"]. Tout en se désolidarisant des violences ayant éclaté en marge des blocages d'établissements, ils ont appelé à des rassemblements mardi 6 octobre et seront rejoints par plusieurs confédérations syndicales dont la CGT. Depuis lundi, environ 5.000 personnes, pour la plupart des adolescents, ont été interpellées dans tout le pays et des dizaines d'autres ont été blessées. Agathe Foucault, porte-parole de la police nationale, a déclaré plus tôt dans la journée sur RTL que plus de 600 policiers avaient également été blessés. Au cours des épisodes de violence, des enseignants et des passants ont été agressés, tandis que les dégâts matériels sont estimés à plusieurs dizaines de millions d'euros. "Quoi qu'ils en disent, ceux qui ont impulsé le mouvement ne le contrôlent plus. Il est ainsi plus que temps de revenir à des formes d'actions pacifiques", déclare Patrick Faure. Le mobilisation lycéenne est partie le 18 septembre d'établissements en [USN:L6N45P01N TEXT:"banlieue parisienne défavorisés"] avant de s'étendre au reste du pays. Plus de 400 lycées - sur un total de quelque 3.700 - sont ainsi restés fermés vendredi. "Nous interviendrons quand il le faudra mais il faut à présent que chacun entende quelles sont ses responsabilités", a déclaré Patrick Faure, en appelant également aux parents. Les élèves qui bloquent les lycées dénoncent notamment des classes surpeuplées, le manque d'enseignants ou encore la vétusté des bâtiments, attribuant ces problèmes à des années de sous-investissement dans le secteur de l'enseignement public.

item.title: England crush Croatia 7-0 as Spain stay perfect with Czech victory
item.description: Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka scored twice apiece as England demolished Luka Modric's Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka on Saturday, but Spain stayed three points clear at the top of their Nations League group with a 3-1 victory over the Czech Republic.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka scored twice apiece as England demolished Luka Modric's Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka on Saturday, but Spain stayed three points clear at the top of their Nations League group with a 3-1 victory over the Czech Republic. Jude Bellingham scored once and provided three assists for England, with Anthony Gordon and substitute Morgan Rogers also on target in a performance captain Kane described as "unbelievable". England are second in League A, Group Three with six points from three matches, behind Spain on nine. Croatia have three points and the Czechs remain pointless. "Unbelievable from start to finish," Kane told ITV. "We spoke a lot about having a 90-minute game from start to finish, being completely dominant with the ball and without the ball. That was it right there." Kane took his international tally to 89 goals in 124 appearances, moving within one cap of Peter Shilton's England record. Asked about potentially drawing level with Shilton against the Czech Republic on Tuesday, Kane said: "Would be nice. That is why he (manager Thomas Tuchel) takes me off, to save me for the next one!" England went ahead after little more than seven minutes when Josko Gvardiol lost possession and Bellingham released Kane, who slipped between two defenders and fired home. Bellingham doubled the lead in the 21st minute after Gordon turned Saka's cross back across goal. Gordon added the third in the 39th, meeting Jarell Quansah's cross with a first-time finish. Mateo Kovacic squandered a close-range chance before Bellingham crossed for an unmarked Saka to score a minute before halftime. Elliot Anderson supplied Kane's second goal with a low cross in the 53rd minute, before Josip Stanisic's misplaced pass across his own box gifted Saka another goal in the 68th. Bellingham released Rogers to complete the rout three minutes from time. "They couldn't live with our pace, with our runs," Kane said. SPAIN KEEP WINNING World and European champions Spain maintained their perfect start in Oviedo despite coach Luis de la Fuente making nine changes to the side that beat Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday. Lamine Yamal opened the scoring in the sixth minute, curling a stunning left-footed shot into the top corner from the edge of the box. After Spain squandered several opportunities, captain Rodri doubled their advantage by converting a rebound inside the area, his first international goal in more than two years.
